endcard: Save this and make it your daily dua

save.ar:
رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً
وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
save.tr: “Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.”

lines.say: Of all the duas he could make, which one did the Prophet make the most?
lines.cap: Of all the duas he could make, which one did the Prophet make the most?

lines.say: Anas reported: this was the dua the Prophet made most often.
lines.cap: This was the dua the Prophet made most often

lines.say: Allah praises it in the Qur'an: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good, and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
lines.cap: “Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good…”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: the good of this world includes well-being, a spacious home, sufficient provision and beneficial knowledge.
lines.cap: The good of this world: well-being, a home, provision, beneficial knowledge

lines.say: The best good of the Hereafter is Paradise, safety from the greatest terror, and an easy reckoning.
lines.cap: The good of the Hereafter: Paradise, safety, an easy reckoning

lines.say: And protection from the Fire starts here: staying away from sins and doubtful matters.
lines.cap: Protection from the Fire starts here: stay away from sins and doubtful matters

lines.say: One short dua that asks for everything. Save it, and share it so someone else says it too.
lines.cap: One dua that asks for everything. Save it & share it 🤍

h1.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً
وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
h1.tr: “O Allah, our Lord! Give us that which is good in this life, that which is good in the Hereafter and save us from the torment of the Fire.”
